sources.snippet: 💡 Overview Masked diffusion language models (LLaDA, Dream, DiffuLLaMA, …) decode by filling a fixed-size canvas. Unlike an autoregressive decoder, which generates until it emits EOS, a masked diffusion decoder must be told how many target slots to fill before denoising begins.

sources.title: [2502.09992] Large Language Diffusion Models
sources.snippet: The LLaDA 8B model undergoes SFT on a dataset comprising 4.5 million pairs. Consistent with the pre-training process, both data preparation and training follow the SFT protocols utilized in existing LLMs (Chu et al. 2024; Yang et al. 2024), without introducing any additional techniques to optimize LLaDA's performance.
